text: Every year, crypto scams drain billions from ordinary people. Here in Nigeria, and across Africa, a victim has no affordable way to find out where their money went. TraceX changes that. Built in Enugu for the Meta AI Developer Hackathon, it is A.I. powered blockchain forensics. Follow the money. Prove it.

This is a real Ethereum transaction from October twenty eighth. I paste it without choosing a chain. TraceX searches seven chains, Ethereum, Base, B N B, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon and Robinhood Chain, and finds where it lives.

In a few seconds it follows the money forward in time. Six hundred E T H lands in this wallet. Within five minutes, all of it goes into Tornado Cash, in six deposits of one hundred E T H. The detectors run in Python with Network X, deployed on Modal. One grouped finding, high severity. Case score, seventy.

Then Meta's Muse Spark, through the Meta Model A.P.I., writes the investigation brief. It only sees the graph and the findings, and it must cite a transaction hash for every claim. Click a citation, and TraceX jumps to that exact transfer, with its full hash and explorer link.
Investigators can ask follow up questions in plain language. Every answer comes back with citations.

Now, something that was not possible before. A victim can generate a records preservation request for the exchange, and a police incident report, in English, Pidgin, Igbo, Yoruba or Hausa. Muse Spark writes the drafts, and TraceX rejects any draft that invents a wallet, or skips a transaction. Companies pay enterprise prices for reports like this. Here, it takes about thirty seconds, for free. This one is in Igbo.
The whole case exports as an evidence report. Findings, graph, the A.I. brief, and every transaction hash, ready to save as a P D F.

The same wallet was also under attack, by address poisoning. Poisoning Shield learns who you really transact with, then flags the impostors. Two addresses copying the real sender's first and last characters, and a fake E T H token for the exact same six hundred E T H. Copy the wrong address from your history, and your money is gone.

TraceX is open source. Next js and TypeScript, Python on Modal, Muse Spark on the Meta Model A.P.I., and seven chains through Alchemy, with unit, integration and live tests running in C I. Built in Enugu. Follow the money. Prove it.
